name: Palash Ranjan Roy
line2: PhD Researcher in Computer Science · University of Saskatchewan
description: I study code clones (how they are detected, refactored and generated), model merging, and efficient large language models for software engineering. I am a PhD researcher in the [Software Research Lab (SRLab)](https://srlab.usask.ca/) and the [Interactive Software Engineering and Analytics (iSE) Lab](https://ise.usask.ca/) at the University of Saskatchewan, supervised by Dr. Kevin Schneider.

highlights.text: Reviewer for IEEE TSE and ACM TOSEM
